{{Quote|I'm Quills. You're with Breakout Squad?''"<br />"''Sharp.''"<br />"''Glad to know you, Sharp. No need to wear your helmet in here.|Quills and a Clawdite shapeshifter impersonating Sharp|<ref name="Guardians" />}}
'''Quills''' was a [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medic]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Quills was part of a team of [[Medic/Legends|medics]] who accompanied a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]]. 

==Biography==
[[File:Chatterbox-StrangeAllies.png|thumb|left|250px|Quills provided medical aid to clone trooper Chatterbox (pictured).]]
Created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who would adopt the name Quills served as a [[Clone medic/Legends|medic]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Medically trained, Quills saw action during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Guardians" /> During [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Quills was a member of a team of [[Medic/Legends|medics]] who joined a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]]. Once they arrived at the depot, Quills and the rest of the team began providing medical aid to fellow clone [[Chatterbox]] who had been shot in the back by a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. They placed Chatterbox onto a stretcher and brought him into the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] they arrived in.<ref name="Guardians" />

Within the trauma center of the cruiser's [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], Quills and the medic team were able to stabilize Chatterbox. During the operation, Quills took notice of a clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] watching through the trauma center's [[Window/Legends|window]] and left the room to talk with the clone. He introduced himself and asked if the clone trooper was with [[Breakout Squad]], to which the clone, who was secretly a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] shapeshifter, replied that his name was [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]], the name of the clone he was impersonating. Quills then informed "Sharp" that he did not need to wear his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] inside the infirmary, prompting the [[Unidentified Clawdite bounty hunter|Clawdite]] to quickly change his facial structure to almost identically resemble Quills' before removing his helmet. Quills informed "Sharp" that they got Chatterbox stabilized, though he would like to get Chatterbox to a recovery facility on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as soon as possible.<ref name="Guardians" />

The Clawdite reported what Quills told him to the rest of Breakout Squad. Fellow squad member [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]] suggested that Quills and Chatterbox could return to Coruscant with them, to which [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] checked with General Fisto and Quills. Deciding the best course of action would be to leave with Breakout Squad, Quills, with the help of Breaker and [[Cleaver]], transferred Chatterbox and the necessary medical equipment to the squad's [[TL-1800 transport|Suwantek freighter]]. Quills also checked up on the [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]] pilots [[Pikkson]] and [[Sunmantle]], confirming that they were fit for duty. Departing from the depot, the squad made the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], taking the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] route to Coruscant. During the journey, Nuru and Breaker checked on Quills who informed them that Chatterbox's condition remained stabled.<ref name="Guardians" />

==Personality and traits==
As a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Guardians" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone of Jango Fett, Quills stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="DB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quills appeared in the [[2012]] young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]'', authored by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Guardians" />
